criteria.description: Filtering must be applied before sorting: the useMemo body in useFilteredProducts.ts must first run all three filter steps (search term → category → inStockOnly) on the full products array, and only then sort the resulting subset.
criteria.evidence: Code inspection of useFilteredProducts.ts lines 20-28 shows all three filter steps (term, category, inStockOnly) applied to `result` before any sort. Sort logic appears at lines 30-36 after filtering is complete. Tests 1, 2, and 4 in derivedStateCorrectness.test.tsx all passed: '✓ price-asc sort within Fitness category produces correct order', '✓ price-desc sort within Electronics category produces correct order', '✓ rating-desc sort within Accessories category produces correct order'. Test run: 21 passed (21).

criteria.description: The sort operation must not mutate the products array stored in ProductContext. The implementation must copy the array before sorting using [...arr].sort(...), arr.slice().sort(...), or arr.toSorted(...).
criteria.evidence: Structural check: grep for 'products\.sort' in useFilteredProducts.ts returned no output — no bare products.sort() call exists. All sort operations use spread: line 31 `result = [...result].sort((a, b) => a.price - b.price)`, line 33 `result = [...result].sort((a, b) => b.price - a.price)`, line 35 `result = [...result].sort((a, b) => b.rating - a.rating)`. The bug injection script confirms the original bug was `products.sort(...)` (bare mutation); the fix changed it to `[...result].sort(...)`.

criteria.description: sortBy must appear in the useMemo dependency array alongside products, debouncedSearch, category, and inStockOnly — all five dependencies must be present.
criteria.evidence: Code inspection of useFilteredProducts.ts line 39: `}, [products, debouncedSearch, category, inStockOnly, sortBy]);` — all five dependencies present. Test 3 passed: '✓ changing sortBy alone — with no other filter changes — triggers recomputation 54ms'. Full test run: 21 passed (21).

criteria.description: When sortBy is 'price-asc' the filtered result must be sorted by price ascending; when 'price-desc' by price descending; when 'rating-desc' by rating descending. When sortBy is the default the insertion order of the filtered set must be preserved.
criteria.evidence: derivedStateCorrectness.test.tsx results: '✓ price-asc sort within Fitness category produces correct order 61ms', '✓ price-desc sort within Electronics category produces correct order 54ms', '✓ rating-desc sort within Accessories category produces correct order 53ms'. Additional sorting.test.tsx: '✓ sorts by price ascending 97ms', '✓ sorts by price descending 35ms', '✓ sorts by rating descending 33ms'. All 21 tests passed.

criteria.description: The only file changed must be src/hooks/useFilteredProducts.ts (and optionally src/utils/productFilters.ts if sort delegation is chosen). No test files under tests/ may be modified.
criteria.evidence: git diff --name-only (working tree) returned no output — no uncommitted changes exist.
